Workers AI has updated pricing to be more granular, with per-model unit-based pricing presented, but still billing in neurons in the back end.
Workers AI is included in both the Free and Paid Workers plans and is priced at $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons.

You can access these models with either the Workers Paid plan or prepaid AI Gateway credits.
You can use prepaid AI Gateway credits to pay for Workers AI inference.
Set the gateway's Workers AI billing setting to Unified billing, then specify that gateway in the AI binding or REST API request.
Neurons are our way of measuring AI outputs across different models, representing the GPU compute needed to perform your request.
The Price in Tokens column is equivalent to the Price in Neurons column - the different units are displayed so you can easily compare and understand pricing.
